# Affittacamere L'Abrì

Guesthouse (affittacamere) in Pontebernardo, a hamlet of Pietraporzio, in the upper Valle Stura, Piedmont, Italy. Five rooms, self check-in with access code from 16:30, check-out by 10:30, self-service breakfast prepared every evening, garage for motorbikes and bicycles, garden, free Wi-Fi. Site available in Italian, English, French and German.

## Pages
- / — Home: rooms, photo gallery, Valle Stura activities, verified ratings, booking request form, map and contacts
- /accesso — Guest access instructions: entrance code, room keys, breakfast room, garage, check-out
- /dove-mangiare — Recommended restaurants in Valle Stura (Pontebernardo, Pietraporzio, Sambuco, Bersezio, Vinadio)
- /privacy — Privacy policy (GDPR)
